verbatim: - PK-ii null vs M0qmc: |Δ| ≤ 0.10 on loop, submit and M5-error.
- Otherwise INTERMEDIATE; direction reported with paired task-bootstrap CIs (1,000 resamples, descriptive).
- Think rate (descriptive, pre-declared label only): "thinking re-opened on the matched base" if the three-seed think rate ≥ 0.50 (v043 M1 on the bf16 base: 0.78; M0q: 0.00).

- Resolution: notable only if ≥ 4 pooled resolved on primary40; all48 and clean36 as sensitivities. All rows reported; exclusions only by the v055/v058 eligibility rule (runner qualification failure or an error outside normal-outcome markers).
- If M5-error is undefined for an arm (no error events in its rollouts), M5 is reported as undefined and PK-i/PK-ii are read on loop and submit only (v057 clause carried over).
